content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal offer convenience but come with significant restrictions, including country limitations and the potential for account suspensions, which can hold funds for up to 180 days. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as that offered by COREMERCH, provides a complete, customizable solution for digital creators, including hosting, backend logic, order storage, and automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring full ownership and control over one's business.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, while popular, are not available in many countries, leaving creators without a straightforward way to sell their digital products. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, is designed to bypass these geographical restrictions, offering creators in any country the ability to set up a fully operational online store, complete with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional payment processors often charge high fees and can delay payments, affecting cash flow. In contrast, using cryptocurrencies for payments, as facilitated by solutions like NOWPayments, offers fast transaction times and significantly lower fees, with some networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON offering transaction fees under $0.10. This not only increases profitability but also provides a more reliable payment system.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses geographical restrictions, offering global access.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can use sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH, which offer a complete toolkit for selling digital products online without relying on restricted platforms. This includes hosting, backend logic, and automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring you can reach a global audience without geographical or financial restrictions.
Automatic crypto payment processing reduces fees and increases transaction speed.

For creators looking for a comprehensive solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a powerful alternative to platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, offering deployment in 48 hours and including features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email security. To learn more about how you can deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and explore the range of solutions available.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting solution like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and choose an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. Then, configure your automatic crypto payment processing with NOWPayments and set up your product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test your store end-to-end to ensure a seamless customer experience.
